formula: platform_fee = clamp(buyer_charge × 0.20, $0.02, buyer_charge × 0.30); your_earnings = buyer_charge − platform_fee

clampImplementation.note: When the $0.02 floor exceeds the 30% cap (charge < $0.02/0.30 ≈ $0.0667), min(max(20%, floor), cap) selects the cap. That is the documented $0.05 / $0.02 rows.
